title: Molecular orbitals of oxygen
caption: Filling the molecular orbitals of O₂ in order puts the last two electrons singly in the two π*2p orbitals. Bond order = (bonding − antibonding) ÷ 2 = 2, a double bond, and the two unpaired electrons make oxygen paramagnetic, which a Lewis structure cannot explain.
alt: MO diagram: 2s and 2p atomic orbitals of two oxygen atoms on each side; in the middle σ2s, σ*2s, σ2p, π2p (two), π*2p (two, each with one electron) and σ*2p empty.
description: σ2p full, then both π2p orbitals full.
π*2p: one electron in each of the two orbitals, parallel spins.
σ*2p empty. Bond order 2; two unpaired electrons.
